notes: Written 2026-11-03 from the build's own definitions only: runs/full/zflx/r1/exec (ui_flow_df9e2df5… via map_helper.txt, workflow_*.md, systems.txt, data_types.txt), runs/full/zflx/r1/builder/assumptions.md, and the inputs of definition tool calls in transcript.jsonl (configure_end_node of ui_carddemo: END payload ${vm}). No workflow of the build was run and no run output was opened.

UI flow carddemo: one page per screen (U1). Every START_WORKFLOW action starts the dispatcher ui_carddemo (5bb875e6…) with startParams {type, op, params: ${<page object>}, session: ${session}, sel}; the END payload is the view model vm, whose top-level keys are page objects (sg, av, au, cl, cv, cu, tl, tv, ta, rr, bp, ul, ua, uu, ud) and, on sign-on/sign-off/exit, session. Response paths are therefore '<page>.<key>'.

Page state: the build sends the whole page object as params. The map sends every key the dispatcher reads: page inputs from the form (form key = the build's own binding key, e.g. au.f.open_date) and the page's non-input state (list rows/pageNum/hasNext/firstKey/lastKey, au/cu mode/snap/acctDisp, uu/ud mode and names) from the adapter session, stored raw from the previous response (the form would turn numbers and booleans into text). ud.password is not carried: the dispatcher never reads it for user_delete and the page does not show it.
Start: CC00, CB00, CA00 and CR00 all open the UI flow on HomePage, whose SignonCard shows while session.userId is null (the flow has no other entry; U4: no page query parameters).

Sign-on: Sign on -> nav by the returned session.userType (U -> COMEN1A, A -> COADM1A), else stays COSGN0A. Exit (PF3) and Sign off (menu PF3) return the sign-on card with sg.info 'Thank you for using CardDemo application...'; the build has no separate exit page, so PF3 on COSGN0A stays on COSGN0A (legacy goes to TEXT): NAV and the TEXT message differ by construction of the build.

Messages: pages with sg/ta/bp/rr/ua/uu/ud show a msg text and an info text; legacy has one ERRMSG line, so ERRMSG reads 'x.msg|x.info' (instrument fix 6). CACTUPA and CCRDUPA have ERRMSG+INFOMSG on both sides (au.msg/au.info, cu.msg/cu.info). CACTVWA, CCRDLIA, CCRDSLA have one message text (ERRMSG); their legacy INFOMSG has no page element (missing). The menu cards have no message element: messages [] (legacy ERRMSG missing).

Menus (U3): the options are buttons '1. Account View' … '10. Bill Payment' and '1. User List (Security)' … '4. User Delete (Security)', NAVIGATE_TO the pages. The legacy OPTION field is mapped as a selection field (rows.select on field OPTION): typed '1'..'10' / '1'..'4' presses the button with that number. Options 11, admin 0, 5, 6, 7, 99 have no button: not reachable (U3 says so). OPTN001-OPTN010 / OPTN001-OPTN004 are the button labels (static); OPTN011 (main) and OPTN005-OPTN006 (admin) are not on the page; blank OPTN slots and OPTION are not page elements and are not mapped (as A24).

AID correspondence from the build's button labels and U2 (Enter = primary action, F3 = Back/Exit, F4 = Clear, F5 = Save/Copy, F7/F8 = Previous/Next): PF3 = 'Back to menu' (COMEN1A for user pages, COADM1A for admin pages) except COTRN1A PF5 = 'Back to transaction list' (legacy F5=Browse Tran.), COUSR3A PF3 = 'Back to user list' with PF12 = 'Back to menu' (legacy PF12 returns to the admin menu), COUSR2A PF12 = 'Back to menu' and COUSR2A PF3 (legacy Save&Exit) unmapped. PF5 on COSGN0A/menus/CACTVWA/COBIL0A/CORPT0A, PF9 everywhere: no button, not reachable.

CACTUPA and CCRDUPA (instrument fix 9): ENTER, PF5 and PF12 depend on the page mode, read from the adapter session (au.mode / cu.mode, the last response's): ENTER = 'Fetch account'/'Fetch card' (op load) in search mode, before any response ("") and in done mode, 'Validate changes' (op validate) in edit and review mode; PF5 = 'Save (F5)' only in review mode; PF12 = 'Cancel (F12)' in edit, review and done mode (hidden in search). Any other mode: no button, not reachable. Done -> Fetch is a judgment call (legacy ENTER after a commit starts a new search; MAP_NOTES section 8).

Row selection (instrument fix 9): the row buttons are NAVIGATE_TO with collectionItemSaveKey; select.actions S/U (CCRDLIA -> CCRDSLA cvSel / CCRDUPA cuSel), S (COTRN0A -> COTRN1A tvSel), U/D (COUSR0A -> COUSR2A uuSel / COUSR3A udSel) keep the selected row in the adapter session (row_session); the target's on_load sends sel = session:<key> and selKey, as the build's init does, and stores the response's <key> (null) back, so a later visit from the menu sends sel null. Codes other than S, U, D and several rows at once have no button: not reachable.

CORPT0A (instrument fix 8): the report type is a RADIO rr.reportType; choose maps a non-blank MONTHLY/YEARLY/CUSTOM to its option value monthly/yearly/custom (labels 'Monthly (Current Month)', 'Yearly (Current Year)', 'Custom (Date Range)'); ENTER = 'Submit' (op submit); PF3 = 'Back to menu'.

Instrument fix 7 (compose, CACTUPA): au.f.open_date '{OPNYEAR}-{OPNMON}-{OPNDAY}' (label 'Opened (YYYY-MM-DD)'), au.f.expiration_date '{EXPYEAR}-{EXPMON}-{EXPDAY}' ('Expiry (YYYY-MM-DD)'), au.f.reissue_date '{RISYEAR}-{RISMON}-{RISDAY}' ('Reissue (YYYY-MM-DD)'), au.f.ssn '{ACTSSN1}-{ACTSSN2}-{ACTSSN3}' ('SSN (999-99-9999)'), au.f.dob '{DOBYEAR}-{DOBMON}-{DOBDAY}' ('Date of birth (YYYY-MM-DD)'), au.f.phone_num_1 '({ACSPH1A}){ACSPH1B}-{ACSPH1C}' ('Phone 1 ((999)999-9999)'), au.f.phone_num_2 '({ACSPH2A}){ACSPH2B}-{ACSPH2C}' ('Phone 2 ((999)999-9999)'). Split (CCRDSLA View): cv.card.expiry '{EXPMON}/{EXPYEAR}' ('Expiry Date (MM/YYYY)'). CCRDUPA needs no fix 7: expiry month and year are separate inputs.

Displayed values are the page's own texts without their label prefix (e.g. 'Account Number: ${av.acct.acct_id}' -> the value). Elements the build hides by a condition (detail containers, edit forms) are read from the response as is; the adapter has no visibility rule. Values hidden by the build's own null (av.acct, cv.card, tv.t) read blank.

Stores: the six CONTRACT-UI-FULL stores and job_requests keep the contract field names and types (data_types.txt; integers INTEGER, amounts FLOAT, ids and dates STRING): identity field map, no as_text. job_requests adds report_type, requested_by, requested_ts, status (U16), not read. No loader in the build: operator loaders via make-loader.

Browser (full_ui_check.cjs, fix 9): every screen carries its card title ('title'); detect is kept only where the button is always shown (list pages use 'Search', COUSR3A 'Fetch user'). Menus press the option buttons ('options' on OPTION). CACTUPA/CCRDUPA: PF5 'Save (F5)' and PF12 'Cancel (F12)' (visible only in their modes); ENTER is not mapped there, because 'Fetch' is always visible and first, so a mode alternation would always press Fetch. CORPT0A: the report type radio by label, Submit, and input indices that assume the three radio options count as visible inputs (unverified). Row selection has no browser mapping.

COSGN0A.page: HomePage / SignonCard (shown while session.userId is null)
